summary: TransCanada PipeLines Ltd filed a Form 6-K furnishing an earnings coverage ratio schedule as of March 31, 2026. The report shows a 2.3 times interest coverage ratio for the trailing twelve months, with interest obligations of $3.376 billion and earnings before interest and taxes of $7.903 billion. This is a routine financial disclosure, equivalent to a US earnings update, with no special-situation transaction, board action, or advisor involvement. The filing is non-transactional and requires no risk-arb analysis; it simply reports statutory financial metrics for regulatory compliance.
